data_fields.name: bad_number_value
data_fields.donor_constant: logged, read as 0 (Frankendom: fail the load instead)

best_idea: Content packs are rows applied in a fixed source order with explicit add, remove and overwrite keywords, and a bad variant is dropped alone (its lost weight logged) instead of disabling the whole fleet.
decision_why: Take the add/remove patch rule and the drop-only-the-bad-variant rule so a zone or legend patch extends a stock list without copying it; reject the player-facing plugin folder for now (Dom only until beta) and reject the lenient number parse (a bad server number fails the load).
acceptance: A server test loads the stock zone rows plus one patch file with add spawn and remove legend rows and asserts the result equals stock with the patch applied; a non-number fails the load naming file and line; a fleet with one invalid variant loads with that variant dropped and the lost weight logged.
